items.text: Abeemilisi babandu basanjila Yesu
Haho lisabo liOmukaate okubulamwo amamela liali ahambi okhuula, elilangwa mbu Pasaka.
Nabo abakhulundu babakuhani nende abahandiichi bali nibakhaabanga shinga olwa ba khamwira, shichila bali nibariitsanga abandu.
Haho Setani yeenjila muYuda owalangwa mbu Isikariote, owali mulala khubeenabo Ekhuminababili.
Naye narula natsia, nasungana nende abakhulundu babakuhani nende abaseesia, shinga olwa yakhamukhoba mumakhono kabwe.
Nabo nibasangaala, nibalakana ninaye okhumuheelesia amapeesa.
Naye nafuchiilila, nakhaaba obwiyangu okhumuhaana mumakhono kabwe olwa abemikanda bakhaba nibabulaho.
Yesu yalia Pasaka halala nabeechibe
Mana inyanga yemikaate echibulamwo amamela niyula, eya bali nibakhoyile okhumalilangakhwo Pasaka.
Naye yaruma Petero naYohana, ari Tsie mukhukasilie Pasaka, khuliekhwo.
Nibamureeba, bari Hali heena aha wenya khukasilie?
Nabasunjila mbu Lole, olwa namube nimwakheenjila mwitookho, mulabukaana nende omusaatsa owituushile isiongo yamatsi; mumulondekhwo munzu ewa aleenjila.
Mana musunjile omusaatsa omwenengo muri Omwechesia akhureeba mbu Shili heena eshisika shiobucheni omwa nendiile Pasaka halala nende abeechi banje?
Naye alamumanyia eshisika eshikali eshiahekulu eshialilwe; mubwenomwo mukasiliemwo.
Nibarula, nibanyoola bario shinga olwa yali nabasunjiile; nibakasia Pasaka.
Ne olwa isaa yali niyulile, niyeekhala, nende abarume abo halala ninaye.
Okhusimikha khwelisabo liOMWAMI
Nababoolela ari Okhwikomba ndiikombile okhulia nineenywe Pasaka yino nishili okhusaalila;
okhuba emuboolela mbu shindakhaliekhwo ta okhuula olwa lilaba niliusiibwe mubwami bwaNyasaye.
Nabukula eshikombe, ne namalile okhukhupa Orio, yasunga ari Bukule kano, mukabane inywe abeene;
okhuba emuboolela mbu okhurula olwa leelo shindalanywa khubiamo biemitsabibu ta okhuula obwami bwaNyasaye olwa buliba nibwitsile.
Mana nabukula omukaate, ne nnmalile okhukhupa Orio, yakusonyola, nabaheelesia, nasunga ari Kuno nomubili kwanje okuhaanwa khulweenywe; mukholenje murio nimunzitsulila.
Eshikombe shiosi ario, olwa bali nibamalile okhulia, nasunga mbu Eshikombe shino neIndakano imbia mumabanga kanje, akeebeenela inywe.
Ne lole, omukhono kwa oyo oukhoba kuli ninasi halala khumeesa yino.
Okhuba toto mwene, Omwana wOmundu yeenyokha, shinga olwa kakasibwa; ne wowe khumundu oyo oumukhoba!
Mana nibachaaka okhureebana abeene nabeene mbu niwina khubo oulakhola likhuwa elo.
Obuyingani khulwa bukhulundu
Nibachaaka okhuyingana mbu niwina khubo oupaarwa mbu nomukhongo?
Naye nabasunjila ari Abaruchi bAbamahanga bali nobwami khubo; nabo ababarukanga balangungwa mbu Abaami bobukoosia.
Ne inywe shimulaba murio ta; nebutswa ouli omukhongo mwinywe, yeekhole shinga omutuutu; nouli omukhulundu, shinga oukhalabana.
Shichila omukhongo ali heena, oyo owikhala khukhulia, nohomba oyo oukhalabana? Shiali oyo owikhala khukhulia? Ne isie endi hakari weenywe shinga oukhalabana.
Ne inywe ninywe abahonjilenje ninasi mukhuteemwa khwanje khwosi
nasi eraho obwami bube obweenywe, shinga Papa olwa yaraho khulwanje,
mbu mulie nimunywa khumeesa yanje mubwami bwanje, ne muliikhala khubifumbi nimuyaasia tsimbia ekhumi natsibili tsiaIsiraeli.
Yesu yaboola khale aka Petero okhumwambakhana
Simoni, Simoni, lola, Setani yasabile inywe, mbu amusekundule shinga ingano;
nebutswa isie ekhusaayiile iwe, mbu obusuubilibwo buleshe okhwakama; nawe olwa olaba niwikalukhasiye, tinyia abashio.
Namusunjila ari Omwami, nindi ninawe ndirecheeshe okhutsia kata mumbohe, kata mukhufwa.
Naye nasunga ari Petero, ekhuboolela mbu itaywa shiyilalakula inyanga yino ta, okhuula olwa olaba niwiyambakhaane okhuula khataru mbu shiumanyile tawe.
Iloloti, nomufuuko, nolukanga
Mana nabareeba ari Olwa ndamuruma ebulafu harali iloloti, kata omufuuko, kata ebilaaro ta, mwatambakhwo eshindu? Nabo bari Tawe.
Nabasunjila ari Ne bulaano, ouli nende iloloti achibukule, nende omufuuko nakwo kurio; ne oubula olukanga, akusie inguboye akule.
Shichila emuboolela mbu knno akahandiikwa kakhoyile okhuusibwa mwisie, mbu Ne yabalilwa halala nende abakhayi; shichila akali khwisie koosibungwa.
Nibamusunjila bari Omwami, lola, tsinganga tsibili nzietsino. Nakalusia mbu Kahelile.
Yesu yasaayila mumukunda
Mana narula, natsia ebunashikulu shiEmitseituni, eshiimashie shinga olwa shialinji, abeechi nibalondana ninave.
Nolwa yali nali habundu tsana, yabasunjila ari Saaye mbu muleshe okhwinjila mukhuteemwa.
Nomwene yaahukhana ninabo hatiiti shinga aha onyala okhulasa lichina; nasikama, nasaaya
naboola mbu Papa, noba nochama, umbiniekhwo eshikombe shino; nebutswa kareekhola akokhwenya khwanje ta, habula akokhukhwo.
Mana malaika yamuloleshela okhurula mwikulu, namumeetela amaani.
Naye, olwa yali mumatinyu yameeta okhusaaya muno; oluchesilwe nalwo nilufwana shinga ebiroonyelesi ebikhongo biamatsayi niluroonyanga hasi.
Ne olwa yarula mukhusaayakhwe, yabeetsela abeechi abo, nabanyoola nibali mundoolo khulwa eshibeela,
nabasunjila ari Mukonanga mbushiina? Buushe, musaaye, mbu muleshe okhwinjila mukhuteemwa.
Yesu yakhobwa, nahambwa
Olwa yali nashisunga, lola, omukanda ngwokwo, nende oyo owalangwa mbu Yuda mulala khwlkhuminababili abo, nakuranjilila; nasita ahambi nende Yesu mbu amutsunzuune.
Ne Yesu namusunjila mbu Yuda, kho omukhoba Omwana wOmundu nomutsunzuuna?
Nabo aba yali ninabo, olwa balola akeetsa okhwikhola shinga olwa kali, bareeba bari Omwami, khubareme nolukanga noho?
Ne oundi khubo nakhupa omusumba wOmukuhani Omukhulundu namurema eshirwi shisaatsa.
Nebutswa Yesu vakalusia, naboola ari Leshele yaho! Natiilakhwo khushirwishie, namuhonia.
Yesu nasunjila abakhulundu babakuhani, nende abaseesia abomuhekalu, nende abakofu, abali nibarulile okhumuyinga, ari Murulile nende tsinganga netsindabushi, shinga abeetsela omunuuli?
Olwa ndabeelenje nineenywe halala muhekalu khatsotselo, shimwachinga amakhono keenywe okhuyinga tawe; ne shino neshise shieenywe nende eshiobunyali bweshiilima.
Petero yamwambakhana Yesu
Nibamuhamba, nibamuyila, nibamuusia ebunanzu wOmukuhani Omukhulundu. Ne Petero yali ehalekhwo namulondangakhwo.
Ne olwa bali nibabwanile omulilo mukari mulwanyi olwo, nibeekhaale bosi halala, Petero yeekhala hakari mubo.
Ne omukhaana undi namulola niyeekhaale aha omulilo kwashilanga, namurangaala butinyu, nasunga mbu Omusaatsa uno yesi yabeele ninaye.
Naye niyeeyambakhana, ari Omukhasi iwe, kata shimumanyile ta.
Hatiitikhwo, oundi namulola, nasunga mbu Nawe wesi oli mulala khubo. Naye Petero naboola ari Omusaatsa iwe, shindikhwo ta.
Nolunyuma Iweshise shinga eshieisaa ndala, oundi yesi yatinyisia okhuboola, ari Toto mwene, omusaatsa uno yesi yabeele ninaye; shichila nomuGalilaya.
Naye Petero naboola mbu Omusaatsa iwe, shimanyile aka osunganga ta. Habwenaho, olwa yali nashiboola itaywa niyilakula.
Omwami nashiukhana, namuhenga Petero. Mana Petero niyeetsulila likhuwa liOmwami, shinga olwa yali namusunjiile, mbu Itaywa niyishili okhulakula leelo ta, naundiyambakhane okhuula khataru.
Narula, nalila bululu.
Yesu yanyokhoosibwa, nanywekhwa
Abandu abali nibamutiilile Yesu bamunyokhoosia, nibamuupa;
nibamutimbia tsimoni, nibamureeba bari Okhulakulile; oukhuupile niwina?
Khandi basunga amakhuwa kandi amanji okhumuyinga nibamunyeka.
Okhuyaasibwa khwaYesu
Ne nibwakhashia, omukhung'aano kwabakofu babandu kwali nikukhung'aanile halala, abakhulundu babakuhani nende abahandiichi bosi; nibamuyila mushiina shiabwe, nibasunga bari
Noba noli iwe Kristo watsana, okhuboolele. Naye nabakalusia mbu Nimba nimuboolela, shimulasuubila ta;
kata nimba nimureeba, shimulakalusia ta.
Ne okhurula olwa leelo Omwana wOmundu aleekhalanga khumukhono musaatsa kwobunyali bwaNyasaye.
Bosi nibamureeba bari Kho niwe Omwana waNyasaye? Nabakalusia ari Ninywe ababoolile murio, shichila isie nisie.
Nabo bari, Khushikhaaba obuloli bundi mbushi? Okhuba ifwe khwakhakahulila mumunwa kukwe omwene.
